author: GamingBolt
description:
S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2’s Update 2.0 is getting ever closer, and we thought it was a good idea to talk about what’s changing in The Zone ahead of its release? That’s because things are about to change quite significantly, and for the better.

This update marks a new chapter for the game thanks to the Cost of Hope expansion bringing new places and story beats to the table. But that doesn’t mean the rest of the game isn’t getting anything new, the update has enough substance to merit its own list of great additions. Well, that’s exactly what we’ve done with this one. Join us to learn more about why S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 is a great choice for your plans next weekend even if you’re not diving into its new DLC just yet.
title: STALKER 2 - Heart of Chornobyl Update 2.0 - 10 BIG Gameplay Changes You NEED TO KNOW

author: GamingBolt
description:
Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker exists as something of an outlier. Originally released for PSP before receiving an HD remaster, this 2010 entry is arguably just as seminal to the series’ as its more widely available titles. 

See, Peace Walker introduced ideas that would later become fundamental to later entries, so it's well worth revisiting Big Boss’ portable adventure as part of Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2. Here’s everything you need to know about Master Collection Vol. 2’s Peace Walker before deciding whether it belongs in your library.
title: Metal Gear Solid Peace Walker (Master Collection Vol. 2) - 15 Things You NEED To Know Before You Buy
